definition: Wall-clock time of the write statements a treatment issues to apply one revision, plus the maintenance statements that treatment requires, measured inside one Spark SQL session on the frozen node
Number of indicator cells a treatment evaluates when applying one revision; for B3 this is the dirty set derived from the H6C lineage edges, for the others it is the full state the treatment rewrites
Total bytes of every object reachable from the metadata of the snapshots a treatment retains, sized from MinIO; unreferenced objects in the table location are reported separately and never counted
Requests for a published figure that the treatment state can still answer exactly, divided by all requests addressed by (cell_id, vintage_id)
Complete paths from a published figure back to a source record, divided by the paths the graph should contain
Bytes a treatment reads while recomputing one revision
Discrepancy events assigned to the vintage, methodology or granularity family by rules R01-R08, divided by all discrepancy events
Revisions readable in the treatment serving state after a run, divided by the revisions admitted in that run; on the H9B validation profile B0 = B1 = B3 = 1.000 and B2 = 8/28 = 0.286
